content.tagline: Coffee processing from partner farms on the slopes of Mount Argopuro.

about.0: Argopuro Walida processes coffee and works together with partner farmers.
about.1: Farm locations are shown as polygons on the public map. A fuller company story can be added later.

process.intro: An overview of the coffee processing flow, from cherry harvest to green bean.

0.title: Cherry harvest
0.text: Coffee cherries are picked at partner farms, and the cherry weight is recorded per farm polygon.

1.title: Sorting
1.text: Cherries are sorted so the fruit entering processing is more uniform.

2.title: Processing
2.text: Cherries are processed with the chosen method (for example washed, honey, or natural).

3.title: Drying
3.text: The coffee is dried until its moisture content is safe for storage and hulling.

4.title: Green bean
4.text: The parchment is removed to produce green beans. Potential GB on the map follows the calculated data.

5.title: Grading and packing
5.text: Beans are sorted, graded, and packed for partners or buyers.
